rentals.title: Fleet rentals & sales
rentals.intro: Motorcycles for the way your business delivers.
rentals.audience: Delivery businesses, restaurants and private fleet owners planning their next motorcycles.
items: Branding requirements to discuss, subject to confirmation
rentals.ask: Tell us your fleet size, operating area, intended start date and whether you need rental or purchase options.
rentals.note: Models, stock, rental terms, deposits, branding and what is included must be confirmed in a quotation.

repairs.title: Servicing & repairs
repairs.intro: Give your working motorcycles the attention they need.
repairs.audience: Businesses maintaining a working fleet and individual owners with a motorcycle that needs attention.
items: On-site servicing enquiries, subject to location and availability
Motorcycle repairs, rebuilds and accident repair enquiries
repairs.ask: Share the motorcycle model, the work or fault you need help with, your location and the number of motorcycles.
repairs.note: Roadside assistance hours, coverage and availability have not been confirmed. Use general enquiries for planning; this is not an emergency dispatch channel.

parts.title: Parts & fabrication
parts.intro: Find the right part. Discuss the right fit.
parts.audience: Fleet operators and motorcycle owners looking for spares, accessories or motorcycle-related fabrication.
items: Crash bars and steel fabrication requirements to discuss
parts.ask: Include the motorcycle make and model, the part or fabrication required, quantities and any measurements you have.
parts.note: Stock, compatibility, fabrication scope and lead times need to be confirmed. No specific part is advertised as available.

support.title: Rider training & fleet support
support.intro: Plan the support around your motorcycles.
support.audience: Businesses reviewing rider needs, motorcycle procurement or the practical running of their fleets.
support.ask: Tell us about your riders, fleet and operating area, and the outcome you are looking for.
support.note: Training format, scope, reporting capabilities and availability require confirmation. No certification or particular reporting system is promised.
